stem.text: The diagram represents, for a given temperature, the Boltzmann distribution of the kinetic energies of the molecules in a mixture of two gases that react together. The activation energy for the reaction, $E_\text{a}$, is marked.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve of molecular energies, with E_a marked on the energy axis

stem.text: The dotted curves below show the Boltzmann distribution for the same reaction at a higher temperature. On these diagrams, H represents the activation energy at the higher temperature.

A.alt: Two Boltzmann curves (solid and dotted); dotted curve peak moved to higher energy; E_a and H marked, H below E_a

B.alt: Two Boltzmann curves; dotted curve peak lower and to the right; H marked left of E_a

C.alt: Two Boltzmann curves; dotted curve peak moved to higher energy and lower; E_a and H marked, H below E_a

D.alt: Two Boltzmann curves; dotted curve peak lower and to the left; E_a and H marked, H below E_a
